tags.name: otc-toolbaritem
tags.description:
The Toolbar Item component can be used inside an `otc-toolbar` as a text button, an icon button, a menu item, or a submenu, depending on
context.  When placed directly inside an `otc-toolbar`, it will be rendered as an `otc-button`.  If this Toolbar Item contains children,
then an `otc-menu` will be created automatically and associated with this `otc-button`.  Toolbar Items that are the child of another
Toolbar Item will be rendered as an `otc-menuitem`, so that they are properly displayed in the aforementioned `otc-menu`.  If this
Toolbar Item also contains children, then it will instead be rendered as an `otc-submenu`.

tags.name: otc-widget-header
tags.description:
The Widget Header component is a container used above widgets like a folder browser or search results. It contains a central title component in the form of a `otc-widget-header-title`, or a variation thereof. It contains slots to the left and right of the title for displaying actions. It also contains a slot below the header bar for displaying additional actions.

**NOTE:** There is no need to place `otc-toolbar` components inside the widget header slots. The widget header already includes similar functionality to `otc-toolbar` internally, so placing a conflicting `otc-toolbar` component in a widget header slot may have undesired behavior. Slots: * ` ` {} - expandIcon An slot that is used to contain the expand icon on the actions bar.
